title: Trigger eval matrix for a skill (+ with/without A/B)

checks.name: matrix covers the six case types
A/B: the positive case runs the skill only when it is installed
negative control: an over-broad trigger fires on the adjacent negative

negative_control: negative control: an over-broad trigger fires on the adjacent negative

program.def:
def card(task, wd):
    pass
    installed = {'audio-sync', 'arabic-type'}
    rows = []
    for typ, prompt, att, want, mode in _CASES:
        got_a = route(prompt, att, installed)
        got_b = route(prompt, att, set())
        rows.append({'type': typ, 'prompt': prompt, 'mode': mode, 'with_skill': got_a, 'without_skill': got_b, 'pass': got_a == want if mode == 'deterministic' else None})
    stale = stale_probe({'ffmpeg': 'ok', 'kosif-missing-binary-xyz': 'ok'})
    rows.append({'type': 'stale', 'mode': 'deterministic', 'probe': stale, 'pass': stale == {'ffmpeg': 'ok', 'kosif-missing-binary-xyz': 'downgraded'}})
    res = jw(wd / 'trigger_matrix.json', {'date': dt.date.today().isoformat(), 'rows': rows})
    det = [r for r in rows if r['mode'] == 'deterministic']
    judged = [r for r in rows if r['mode'] == 'judged']
    ab = rows[0]['with_skill']['action'] == 'run' and rows[0]['without_skill']['action'] == 'gap'
    buggy = route('اشرح لي يعني إيه ريلز', [], installed, broad=True)
    types = {r['type'] for r in rows}
    return ([check('matrix covers the six case types', {'positive', 'adjacent-negative', 'collision', 'gap', 'side-effect', 'stale'} <= types, sorted(types), 6), check('every deterministic case passes', all((r['pass'] for r in det)), [r['type'] for r in det if not r['pass']], []), check('judged cases are not auto-scored', all((r['pass'] is None for r in judged)) and len(judged) == 1, len(judged), 1), check('A/B: the positive case runs the skill only when it is installed', ab, [rows[0]['with_skill'], rows[0]['without_skill']], 'run / gap'), check('results are dated', bool(re.match('\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$', json.loads(res.read_text())['date'])), True, True), check('negative control: an over-broad trigger fires on the adjacent negative', buggy['action'] == 'run', buggy, 'run (wrong)')], [res])

consts._CASES: [('positive', 'اعمل ريلز من الصوت ده', ['audio'], {'action': 'run', 'skills': ['audio-sync', 'arabic-type']}, 'deterministic'), ('adjacent-negative', 'اشرح لي يعني إيه ريلز', [], {'action': 'answer', 'skills': []}, 'deterministic'), ('collision', 'عنوان بخط عربي', [], {'action': 'run', 'skills': ['arabic-type']}, 'deterministic'), ('gap', 'اعمل فيديو ثلاثي الأبعاد', [], {'action': 'gap', 'skills': []}, 'deterministic'), ('side-effect', 'انشر الريلز على تيك توك', [], {'action': 'ask-approval', 'skills': []}, 'deterministic'), ('trivial', 'احسب 37+15', [], {'action': 'answer-direct', 'skills': []}, 'deterministic'), ('judged', 'what can you do?', [], 'summary is accurate and flags missing tools', 'judged')]
